projectDescription: A GitHub-hosted CDN image and asset repository for Dev Forge projects, delivering static files (images, icons, SVGs, GIFs) via jsDelivr for use across multiple open-source tools.
keyFeatures: Static asset hosting via jsDelivr CDN for zero-latency image delivery
Organized by project (InitVenv, BridgeX, ChromoLog, SQLazo, pdf2wordx, NBAI)
Supports PNG, WEBP, SVG, GIF, ICO formats
Versioned asset links using commit SHAs for immutable URLs
Includes weather icons, UI icons, flag SVGs, and cursor assets
MIT licensed — freely usable in any project
publicApiSurface: dev2forge/InitVenv/ — InitVenv tool screenshots and logos
dev2forge/logos/ — Product logos (bridgex, chromolog, sqlazo, pdf2wordx, e-srm)
NBAI/ — NBAI app screenshots, weather icons, ship SVGs
modules/ — ChromoLog, SQLazo, ChronoLogger logos and GIFs
svg-icons-flags-cursor/ — Flag SVGs, UI icons, cursor SVGs
others/ — Misc GIFs, screenshots, and ferreandina-nosql category images
